WinDV 2.2.1 makes the downloads about a third of their previous size. WinDV 2.2 added an installer, and both are available below.

## Download

- **WinDV-2.2.1-x64-Setup.exe**: the installer for 64-bit Windows (almost every PC).
- **WinDV-2.2.1-x64-portable.zip**: the same app without installing. Unzip anywhere and run `WinDV.exe`.
- **WinDV-2.2.1-x86-Setup.exe** and **WinDV-2.2.1-x86-portable.zip**: the same for 32-bit Windows.

Requires Windows 10 or 11. Your settings from earlier versions (or the original WinDV) carry over.

## What's new

- **Much smaller downloads**: the 64-bit installer is now about 16 MB (was 45 MB), and the portable zip about 24 MB (was 68 MB). The app is now compiled ahead of time, so it no longer ships its own copy of the .NET runtime. It still needs nothing else installed.
- **Installer** (new in 2.2): installs for your account without an administrator prompt, or for all users if you choose. It adds *WinDV 2* to the Start menu and to *Settings > Apps*, so it isn't confused with an installed original WinDV. Uninstalling keeps your settings.
- **Tidier portable zip** (new in 2.2): the top of the folder holds just `WinDV.exe` and the README. The rest of the app is in the `app` folder.
